name: Tsujikaze Touya
source:
Race: Human
Code Name: Homura
Second Year at Espiona Girls' Academy
Assigned Class: Free

A descendant of ninjas living in the modern world. A second-year student. He’s a carefree joker who loves boobs, but he has a strong sense of family and is someone you can count on when it really matters. After losing his father, he resolved to protect his older sister and mother.  When he opened a scroll left behind by his father, he was transported to another world along with his older sister and mother. At the spy academy in this new world, he was entrusted with a certain “mission” by the academy’s chairman. And so, he found himself living a life in another world as a student at the spy academy!

[spoiler]Despite being somewhat at odds with his father due how harsh Enzou was with his love and expectations of his son, Touya respects his father still, the man went out fighting to protect his family, Touya takes upon Enzou's fearsome field nickname of Homura as his codename at Espiona Girl's Academy.[/spoiler]
